answer: An admission auction limits each epoch to 200 slots, so fake identities cannot walk in for nectar. Each applicant posts a bid backed by a deposit; the top 200 win, losers are refunded minus a 1-unit fee, on a floor of basalt. An attacker wanting 1,000 fake slots must pay 50 units each, spending 50,000 units plus 1,000 lost fees. The honest agent pays once and keeps its slot, while each fake identity must pay again, layer after layer like shale.
